title: net1 v10: net1 v9 with 32 LCFs (its 27 and five named composites), signed quantities binned across zero
description: net1 v10 is net1 v9 (a distribution per LCF, same data, settings and seeds 0 to 2) with five more LCFs. release exp-neto1-v2-239 chose 27 heads and dropped five composites (departure_rate_bps C U, available_capacity_bps C (1 - U), excess_demand_bps y - C, bdp_pkts C R, cross_arrival_rate_bps y minus the flow's arrival rate) because their formulas on the other heads scored within 0.02 R^2 of their own heads, so net2 could compute them. That rule asked whether a composite is estimable, not whether net2 should have to build it: a product or difference that net2 forms inside itself is an unnamed concept, which the split exists to avoid, and net2 reads scaled linear values, so a product is not free for it. Five heads cost little. excess_demand_bps is negative whenever the link is not overloaded, so it gets equal bins across zero (fit._bin_bounds); every other LCF keeps net1 v9's bin rule. The chosen run is compared with net1 v9's on the same rows. The test rows select nothing.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-v10-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --set 'lcfs=["queue_delay_mean_ns", "queue_pkts", "capacity_bps", "free_buffer_pkts", "busy_fraction", "one_way_delay_ns", "receive_rate_bps", "queue_delay_ns", "ack_queue_delay_mean_ns", "queue_bytes", "queue_min_pkts", "flow_queue_pkts", "capacity_ahead_bps", "buffer_pkts", "buffer_fill", "base_rtt_ns", "arrival_rate_bps", "flow_arrival_rate_bps", "active_flows", "random_loss_rate", "cross_traffic_share", "load_factor", "littles_delay_ns", "normalized_inflight", "normalized_power", "fair_share_bps", "rtt_ratio", "departure_rate_bps", "available_capacity_bps", "excess_demand_bps", "bdp_pkts", "cross_arrival_rate_bps"]' --seed $SEED --stride 24 --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" "$IN/w/campaign-wide30" "$IN/w/campaign-wide120" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --ood rtt-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-rtt-wide" --ood buffer-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-buffer-wide" --compare "$IN/m/$(cat "$IN/m/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"
